title: 03_streamvault_terms
summary: StreamVault is a monthly subscription that automatically renews and can change its price with notice. You can cancel anytime, but you won’t get money back for the rest of the month. The service may remove movies or shut down your account if you break the rules, and any legal fights will be handled in Singapore courts.
keyPoints: Your subscription renews each month automatically; cancel to stop future charges.
If you cancel, you won’t receive a refund for the unused part of the month.
Prices can increase after 30 days notice; you can cancel to avoid the higher price.
The company can remove titles from the library at any time.
Breaking the rules or suspected fraud can lead to immediate account termination and loss of remaining fees.
Disputes are resolved in Singapore courts.

risks.clauseQuote: Your StreamVault subscription bills monthly in advance and renews automatically on the same date each month until you cancel.
risks.explanation: The subscription will keep charging you every month unless you turn it off, so you could keep paying without noticing.

risks.clauseQuote: You can cancel any time in account settings; cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period and we do not refund partial months.
risks.explanation: If you stop the service, you’ll still be charged for the whole month and won’t get money back for the unused days.

risks.clauseQuote: Prices may change with 30 days notice. If you do not agree to a price change you may cancel before the new price takes effect.
risks.explanation: The company can raise the price after a month’s notice, and if you don’t like it you have to cancel to avoid paying more.

risks.clauseQuote: Your right to use StreamVault terminates automatically if you breach these terms. We may also terminate your account for suspected fraud, in which case remaining fees are forfeited.
risks.explanation: If you break the rules or are suspected of fraud, they can shut your account and keep any money you’ve already paid.

risks.clauseQuote: We may remove content from the library at any time and we do not guarantee that any title will remain available.
risks.explanation: Shows or movies you like might disappear whenever the service decides.

risks.clauseQuote: To the fullest extent permitted by law StreamVault's aggregate liability is limited to the fees you paid in the 6 months preceding the claim.
risks.explanation: If something goes wrong, the most they’ll ever pay you is what you spent in the last six months.

disclaimer: This is an automated plain-language summary, not legal advice. Check the original document for anything that matters to you.
